title: ヒシアマ姐さんの弱点？

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hm, those clouds are looking kind of rough. I'd better book it home before the rain starts comin' down.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Damn it, I'm no good with thunder! I keep freezing up when I hear it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I'm so pathetic. Please don't strike anywhere near here! Pleeease!
